14731-hatchie-the-guardian-slave-or-the-.creator: Warren T. Ashton.
14731-hatchie-the-guardian-slave-or-the-.description: A book by Warren T. Ashton.. But, as its _locale_ is the South, and its principal character a slave, the story incidentally portrays some features of slavery. With these explanations, the author submits the tale to the public, hoping the reader will derive some portion of the pleasure from its perusal which he experienced in its preparation. arxiv-1709-03562.title: False arrhythmia alarm reduction in the intensive care unit Conference: MIT 6.UAR; MAY 2017; Cambridge, Massachusetts
arxiv-1709-03562.creator: Andrea S. Li, Alistair E. W. Johnson, Roger G. Mark
arxiv-1709-03562.description: Abstract . Research has shown that false alarms constitute more than 80% of the alarms triggered in the intensive care unit (ICU). The high false arrhythmia alarm rate has severe implications such as disruption of patient care, caregiver alarm fatigue, and desensitization from clinical staff to real life-threatening alarms.

arxiv-2202-07419.title: Characterising Cybercriminals: A Review
arxiv-2202-07419.creator: Matthew Edwards, Emma Williams, Claudia Peersman & Awais Rashid
arxiv-2202-07419.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Matthew Edwards, Emma Williams, Claudia Peersman & Awais Rashid. Executive Summary This review provides an overview of current research on the known characteristics and motivations of offenders engaging in cyber-dependent crimes. Due to the shifting dynamics of cybercriminal behaviour, and the availability of prior reviews in 2013, this review focuses on original research conducted from 2012 onwards, although some older studies that were not included in prior reviews are also considered.

arxiv-2307-16655.title: Calculating composite-particle spectra in Hamiltonian formalism and demonstration in 2-flavor QED 𝟏 + 𝟏 ​ d {}_{1+1\text{d}} Preprint: YITP-23-98, RIKEN-iTHEMS-Report-23 arXiv: 2307.16655
arxiv-2307-16655.creator: Etsuko Itou, Akira Matsumoto, and Yuya Tanizaki
arxiv-2307-16655.description: Abstract We consider three distinct methods to compute the mass spectrum of gauge theories in the Hamiltonian formalism: (1) correlation-function scheme, (2) one-point-function scheme, and (3) dispersion-relation scheme. The first one examines spatial correlation functions as we do in the conventional Euclidean Monte Carlo simulations. The second one uses the boundary effect to efficiently compute the mass spectrum.

arxiv-2308-14401.title: CodeMark: Imperceptible Watermarking for Code Datasets against Neural Code Completion Models Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM Joint European Software Engineering Conference and Symposium on the Foundations of Software Engineering; December 3–9, 2023; San Francisco, CA, USA Proceedings of the
arxiv-2308-14401.creator: Zhensu Sun, Xiaoning Du, Fu Song, Li Li
arxiv-2308-14401.description: Abstract . Code datasets are of immense value for training neural-network-based code completion models, where companies or organizations have made substantial investments to establish and process these datasets. Unluckily, these datasets, either built for proprietary or public usage, face the high risk of unauthorized exploits, resulting from data leakages, license violations, etc.

arxiv-2311-01566.title: Robust zero modes in non-Hermitian systems without global symmetries
arxiv-2311-01566.creator: Jose D. H. Rivero, Courtney Fleming, Bingkun Qi, Liang Feng, Li Ge
arxiv-2311-01566.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jose D. H. Rivero, Courtney Fleming, Bingkun Qi, Liang Feng, Li Ge. We present an approach to achieve zero modes in lattice models that do not rely on any symmetry or topology of the bulk, which are robust against disorder in the bulk of any type and strength. Such symmetry-free zero modes (SFZMs) are formed by attaching a single site or small cluster with zero mode(s) to the bulk, which serves as the “nucleus” that expands to the entire lattice.

arxiv-2311-09171.title: Harada-Maxwell Static Spherically Symmetric Spacetimes
arxiv-2311-09171.creator: Alan Barnes
arxiv-2311-09171.description: Abstract Very recently Harada has proposed a gravitational theory which is of third order in the derivatives of the metric tensor with the property that any solution of Einstein’s field equations (EFEs) possibly with a cosmological constant is necessarily a solution of the new theory.

arxiv-2509-20939.title: Unlocking Noise-Resistant Vision: Key Architectural Secrets for Robust Models
arxiv-2509-20939.creator: Bum Jun Kim, Makoto Kawano, Yusuke Iwasawa & Yutaka Matsuo
arxiv-2509-20939.description: Abstract While the robustness of vision models is often measured, their dependence on specific architectural design choices is rarely dissected. We investigate why certain vision architectures are inherently more robust to additive Gaussian noise and convert these empirical insights into simple, actionable design rules.

arxiv-2510-06524.title: Stable central limit theorems for discrete-time lag martingale difference arrays
arxiv-2510-06524.creator: Walter Dempsey, Easton Huch
arxiv-2510-06524.description: Abstract Recent work in dynamic causal inference introduced a class of discrete-time stochastic processes that generalize martingale difference sequences and arrays as follows: the random variates in each sequence have expectation zero given certain lagged filtrations but not given the natural filtration.

arxiv-2602-11852.title: Prototype Transformer: Towards Language Model Architectures Interpretable by Design
arxiv-2602-11852.creator: Yordan Yordanov Matteo Forasassi Bayar Menzat Ruizhi Wang Chang Qi Markus Kaltenberger Amine M’Charrak Tommaso Salvatori Thomas Lukasiewicz
arxiv-2602-11852.description: Abstract While state-of-the-art language models (LMs) surpass the vast majority of humans in certain domains, their reasoning remains largely opaque, undermining trust in their output. Furthermore, while autoregressive LMs can output explicit reasoning, their true reasoning process is opaque, which introduces risks like deception and hallucination.

pmc-11466402.title: Optimization of individualized faricimab dosing for patients with diabetic macular edema: Protocol for the SWAN open-label, single-arm clinical trial
pmc-11466402.creator: Takao Hirano, Toshinori Murata, Shintaro Nakao, Masahiko Shimura, Miho Nozaki, Kiyoshi Suzuma, Taiji Nagaoka, Masahiko Sugimoto, Yoshihiro Takamura, Tomoaki Murakami, Keisuke Iwasaki, Jun Tsujimura, Shigeo Yoshida, Jiro Kogo, Jiro Kogo, Jiro Kogo
pmc-11466402.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeIn patients with diabetic macular edema (DME) from YOSEMITE/RHINE, dual angiopoietin-2/vascular endothelial growth factor-A (VEGF-A) inhibition with faricimab resulted in visual/anatomic improvements with extended dosing. The SWAN trial (jRCTs031230213) will assess the efficacy, durability, and safety of faricimab during the treatment maintenance phase in patients with DME using a treat-and-extend (T&E)-based regimen adapted to clinical practice and the characteristics of patients achieving extended dosing intervals.MethodsSWAN is a 2-year, open-label, single-arm, interventional, multicenter trial enrolling adults with center-involving DME.

pmc-11633987.creator: Rashida-E Ijdi, Janine Barden-O’Fallon, Michelle L. Munro-Kramer, Emma Campbell, Kahsay Zenebe Gebreslasie, Kahsay Zenebe Gebreslasie, Kahsay Zenebe Gebreslasie
pmc-11633987.description: ObjectiveIntimate Partner Violence (IPV) continues to be a major global public health concern, impacting physical and psychological well-being of individuals, including their reproductive and sexual health. The objective of this study is to examine the association between physical intimate partner violence and the utilization of contraception during the postpartum period in the United States.

pmc-12610666.creator: Juan Dong, Zhaoyu Yang, Qiongyu Yuan, Weidong Zeng, Yuling Mi, Caiqiao Zhang, Sang Woo Kim

pmc-12618271.title: Repair and Treatment of Type B Aortic Dissection With Patent Ductus Arteriosus–Related Internal Leakage: A Case Report
pmc-12618271.creator: Xiaolong Li, Yayun Xiao, Yulin Zhang, Liwei Zhang
pmc-12618271.description: The coexistence of patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) and aortic dissection aneurysm is a rare clinical occurrence. We report a case of a 51‐year‐old female presenting with type B aortic dissection and PDA‐related internal leakage. Initial management involved thoracic endovascular aortic repair with a single‐branch stent graft.

pmc-13254199.title: Pulmonary vein stenosis after pediatric heart transplantation: incidence and risk factors
pmc-13254199.creator: Hyun Soo Lee, Han Ki Park, Sang On Lee, Yu Rim Shin
pmc-13254199.description: ObjectivesPostoperative pulmonary vein stenosis (PVS) is an uncommon but potentially serious complication following pediatric heart transplantation. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of PVS and identify donor- and recipient-related predictors.MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed pediatric patients (<18 years) who underwent heart transplantation at a single center between 2003 and 2024.
